sentences.japanese: 君は大きな危険を冒しながら、彼に任せている事になる。
sentences.english: You're running a big risk in trusting him.

sentences.japanese: 我々は彼にその問題を任せざるを得なかった。
sentences.english: We had no choice but to leave the matter to him.

sentences.japanese: 最終決定は彼に任せた。
sentences.english: We left the final decision to him.

sentences.japanese: 何をするかを決めるのは、あなたに任せます。
sentences.english: It is up to you to decide what to do.
